verdict.line: You lose if you facetank Sett once his Grit bar fills and his R (The Show Stopper) is up; you win if you poke him down at range before he ever gets to swing.

brief.thesis: Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) range of 800 outranges every tool Sett has until level 6, so the lane is a poke war Urgot should win on paper. The 51.4% win rate over 1439 games and Sett's solo-kill edge come from his E (Facebreaker) stun setups and R (The Show Stopper) hard engage turning one bad walk-up into a dead Urgot.

theirWindow.when: Sett's stored Grit is visibly full
theirWindow.what: He can dump W (Haymaker) for a shield plus true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides. Don't be standing in melee range when that bar maxes out; back off or be ready to answer it immediately.

yourWindow.when: Sett's E and W are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step up and free-hit with Q (Corrosive Charge) and autos. He has no stun, no burst, and no gap closer in this window, so it's pure poke for you.

start.why: 50.2% win rate over 1495 games and 85.4% pick rate; the extra damage and sustain let you win the extended auto-poke exchanges Urgot's range sets up.

boots.why: 49.4% win rate over 1277 games, 75.7% pick rate. Sett's kit is entirely physical (alternating punches, Q's bonus max-health damage, W's physical side-hits), so flat physical reduction blunts every one of his damage sources.

core.why: 50.6% win rate in this build path (22.1% pick); the armor shred punishes Sett for standing in your Q/auto poke and speeds up kills once he's forced to engage.
Same path; the health and tenacity-adjacent bulk cushion the one bad trade if he lands E (Facebreaker) or opens with R.
Completes the 50.6% path; stacking resistances scales directly against a melee all-in champion who has to walk into your range to do anything.

you need to close distance after poking him low instead of waiting for him to walk in

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the consecutive Q-and-auto poke pattern that defines this matchup, stacking a damage amplifier on Sett before he ever closes distance.

summoners.why: 49.6% win rate, 81.8% pick rate. Ignite punishes Sett's passive health regen from missing health, turning poke damage into kill pressure; Flash lets you step out of range before his Grit bar or R threshold closes the gap.

playing.title: Poke at max Q range
playing.detail: Keep Corrosive Charge (CD 10-8s, range 800) on cooldown from outside his auto range. He has no ranged tool to answer it until he's forced to walk up.

playing.title: Answer his W with your E
playing.detail: When Sett's Grit bar is full and he commits Haymaker, use Disdain's shield to blunt the hit and reposition out of his melee range rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Don't get boxed in for Facebreaker
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if you're caught between enemies on opposite sides; stay on one side of the wave or wall so it only slows you instead.

playing.title: Respect the Knuckle Down window
playing.detail: When his Q is off cooldown (9-5s), his next two autos carry bonus max-health damage. Don't facetank through that window; disengage or answer with Purge instead.

playing.title: Play around level 6 onward
playing.detail: The Show Stopper (CD 120-80s, range 400) is his only hard engage and matches the data's solo-kill edge for him. Track it with vision and don't overextend once he hits 6.

playing.title: Hold E for escape past level 9
playing.detail: Once he has core items, save Disdain's dash-and-shield to get out rather than to engage; the matchup data favors his all-in, not yours.

playing.title: Finish with R once he's chipped low
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death (CD 100-70s, range 2500) executes below the health threshold. Let your poke bring him there before you commit the ultimate.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, item and rune win rates, and summoner picks are pulled from measured Urgot vs Sett games on the current patch (1439 games, 51.4% win rate); the ability-timing and trade-pattern reasoning above is our own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Sett activate (P) by constantly using basic attack and [Q]. Use [E] when Sett uses (W).
